Inventory Write-off

The Inventory Write-off view displays comprehensive details about a specific inventory write-off transaction, including the date, reference number, and description.

The view presents a table showing all inventory items being written off, with their item codes, item names, and quantities.

You can click the Edit button to modify the write-off details, change quantities, add or remove items, or update the reference and description.

For more information, see: Inventory Write-off — Edit
